The marketplace corpus SOURCE — the candy-dir charly.yml that makes
`charly marketplace generate --root <this repo>` work post-cutover. It
references pod-charly-hooks (the single `marketplace:` entity + the harness
gate hooks) and every standalone candy repo that owns `skill:` / `hook:`
entities, so readKinds' CollectEntitiesRemote resolves the full corpus
transitively. The family dirs at this repo's root are the GENERATED corpus,
not the source — regeneration is a no-op on a clean tree (the drift gate).
